scope: Static read-only v2 repeat plus parent-authorized isolated AST functions/statements against create-only private fixtures; no whole-helper/ROOT/Git execution, tests/builds/staging/cleanup/source edits.

closed_findings.scope: Initial validation now derives exact ordered all/normal/force plans from pinned rows; initial omission/reordering and invalid paths/actions refused. Later reread remains separately open.

Both phases now compare full audited permission mode, bytes/SHA and within-hash stat identity; staged absent entries verify current absence. Mode changes, recreated/dangling paths, parent symlink and same-byte inode replacement refused in isolated checks.

findings.finding: After pinned audit-derived expected_paths is validated, plan files are reread into plan/paths/normal/force. A plan change between these blocks can replace the authority with a reduced self-consistent set. Later staged exact-set and blob verification then use the reduced set, so previously validated audit rows may be omitted.
findings.proof: 22-case isolated receipt includes explicit initial guard acceptance, then reduced all/normal/force file writes, then acceptance of extracted reread statements with paths != expected_paths. No actual ROOT or Git operation executed.
findings.minimal_fix: Set paths from immutable expected_paths and derive plan/normal/force byte lists from pinned rows rather than rereading after validation. Recheck audited metadata/plan hashes at the final bookend if output promises stability of those files.

observations: Completion metadata is no longer initial plan authority; file membership/length/SHA and audit SHA are checked.
Whitespace result remains separate metadata requiring parent inspection.
